card.title: My stars
card.allReached: You've got enough for every reward!
card.noBonuses: The shop has no active rewards yet.
card.off: This shop doesn't use a star card.
card.availableHint: Ask your barber when you pay.
card.rule: You earn 1 star per visit: a completed appointment or a service paid at the counter. If the ticket is cancelled, that star is removed. Claiming a reward takes its stars off.
card.historyEmpty: Nothing yet. Your first visit gives you your first star.
card.invalid: This link no longer works. Ask your barbershop for a new one.

reason.returned: Ticket cancelled: the reward went back to the card

staff.reasonHint: It stays in the history with your name and the time.
staff.deliverBody: {count} stars will be taken off {name}'s card. Use this for things that don't go through the register; if you're charging it, apply it from Register.
staff.delivered: Reward handed over. It's in the history.
staff.noPermission: Only people who take payments can give or remove stars and hand over rewards.
staff.linkHint: A link just for this client: it opens their star card and nothing else. Send it or let them scan the QR.
staff.revokeConfirm: The link they already have will stop working and a new one is created. Sure?
staff.revoked: Link revoked. Here's the new one.

bonos.title: Stars & rewards
bonos.rule: 1 star per visit: a completed appointment or a service paid at the counter without one. If you cancel the ticket, the star goes away by itself. Whoever takes payments can also give or remove a star by hand, with a reason.
bonos.listHint: Each reward costs stars. Clients see how many they need for the next one and what it is.
bonos.name: Reward name
bonos.legacy: This is the reward you already had: it became your first reward and your clients keep all their stars.
bonos.sqlPending: To create more rewards, sql/barber_estrellas.sql has to be applied. Meanwhile you can rename the current reward and change its stars.
bonos.noPermission: Only the owner or the manager can create and edit rewards.
bonos.configNote: Rewards and how many stars each one costs are edited in Clients → Stars & rewards.

caja.noStar: This ticket doesn't add a star (no service on it).
caja.needsService: Add {service} to the ticket to use this reward.
caja.bonusGift: Hand over: {text}. It's noted on the ticket.
caja.cardSentWa: {name} got their star card on WhatsApp.
caja.cardQueuedWa: Their star card is on its way on WhatsApp.
caja.sendCardManualHint: It didn't go out on its own: open it and send it from your phone.
caja.sendCardManualHintFree: It didn't go out on its own because the client hasn't messaged you in 24 h and Meta would charge for it. Send it from your phone (free).
